summary: The guide page adheres strictly to the plan, research context, and boundary constraints. It covers role-specific training, sandbox workflow simulations, staged rollout across docks and outsourced processors, and adoption/throughput measurement. Primary research from the ISO 9001 APG external providers guidance and ICC Supplier Quality module documentation is accurately represented, with proper qualification regarding pending portal capabilities and mandatory human-in-the-loop verification of AI outputs. All assigned workflow roles, inputs, decisions, records, exceptions, software evaluation criteria, and labeled hypothetical examples are fully incorporated. No unassigned FAQ section is present.
